elements.label: Figure 4.11: Dissimilarity index in education and health
elements.description: Vertical bar chart. Y-axis: 'Dissimilarity Index', scale 0.00 to 0.20 (gridlines at 0.05 intervals). Categories grouped under three headers: 'Health' (Access to flush toilet, Access to safe water, Access to health insurance), 'Education enrollment' (Enrolled in school), and 'One time completion' (Some primary, Primary, Lower secondary, Upper secondary). Printed values: Access to flush toilet 0.058; Access to safe water 0.044; Access to health insurance 0.050; Enrolled in school 0.014; Some primary 0.001; Primary 0.009; Lower secondary 0.056; Upper secondary 0.155. Source: World Bank staff calculations using VHLSS 2020. The pattern: dissimilarity is low for most indicators (under 0.06), and it rises sharply at upper secondary completion, the highest bar.
